caveats: Scope-(a) for the numbers: one nucleus, one pin, and the functional form B = -alpha ln mu, which qou-19jc's own redirect places under suspicion (qou-kj4v: flavour-only mu cannot split 3S1 from 1S0). If that form is wrong, these MeV figures move; the mu figures and the identity do not.

The structural note -- every admissible interface element is a*sigma + b*I, so mu = a*z_D + b sweeps all of R and cannot select an element -- excludes a SEARCH STRATEGY, not any ingredient. A space-indexed derived element (qou-vbyi) would arrive with its own (a, b) and is untouched by it.

No claim that qou-19jc's quoted required mu is wrong for its purpose: it agrees to 4 significant figures and its 13.5 % conclusion is unaffected. The point is only that an effect of 7.2e-5 cannot be assessed against a value carrying 8.1e-5 of slack.
